The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Monday, Aug, 10 2026 US stock futures are pointing higher this morning, with the S&P 500 contracts up around 0.6%, as investors weigh softer US jobs data against falling bond yields and cooler inflation expectations. July nonfarm payrolls showed a small job loss of 23,000 and weaker wage growth, which signals a slowing job market and less pressure from pay rises. Host Kenny Polcari joins Yahoo Finance's Jared Blikre and Founder ETFs' Michael Monaghan to explore the data showing why founder-led companies significantly outperform the market. The panel also breaks down the flawless execution of the SpaceX IPO, the overlooked opportunities in AI infrastructure, and why the next major productivity boom will mirror the historical shift from steam to electricity.

Micron keeps getting dismissed as a cyclical chip stock doomed to repeat the same boom-and-bust pattern, but one structural shift buried in its latest earnings call suggests that logic no longer applies the way investors assume.

In late July 2026, Vertiv Holdings Co reported second-quarter results showing higher revenue and net income year over year, completed its US$599.84 million share repurchase program, and raised both third-quarter and full-year 2026 guidance, while earlier in August Bitzero Holdings Inc. announced a collaboration with Vertiv to support AI and HPC data center build-outs.
